skeleton.keyframes: 0%,42% { opacity: 1; timing steps(4) } 50%,92% { opacity: .55; timing steps(4) } 100% { opacity: 1 }

status-ping.gate: none on the plain utility (AgentBrowserCursor.tsx:88 adds motion-reduce:animate-none); motion-safe:animate-status-ping also ships (ConnectionStatusDot.tsx:40)

stash-pulse-row.keyframes: from,85.7% { color: var(--color-foreground) } (then eases back over the last 200ms)

stash-pulse-row-alt.keyframes: identical to stash-pulse-row (alternated to restart without remount)

live-activity-focus.keyframes: from { transform: translateX(0) } to { transform: translateX(100%) }
live-activity-focus.gate: off (and opacity 0) under reduced motion or forced colors

live-activity-focus-counter.keyframes: from { transform: translateX(0) } to { transform: translateX(-100%) }

preview-loading-progress.keyframes: from { transform: scaleX(.04) } to { transform: scaleX(.9) }

settings-search-target-pulse.keyframes: 0%,100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0 transparent } 50% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-primary) 70%, transparent) }

sidebar-drag-label-reveal.keyframes: from { visibility: hidden } to { visibility: visible }

settings-slider-thumb.value: transition: transform 120ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease; hover scale(1.08), active scale(0.94)

t3-mobile-draft-headline-exit.keyframes: from { opacity: 1; translateY(0) } to { opacity: 0; translateY(-6px) }
